semiconductor_relevance: High — GreenTrans Corporation provides specialized AMR and AGV solutions for semiconductor manufacturing and logistics.
summary: GreenTrans Corporation develops and manufactures Automated Mobile Robots (AMR) and Automated Guided Vehicles (AGV) specifically for the semiconductor industry. Their solutions enhance material handling efficiency in wafer manufacturing, packaging, and testing facilities, integrating with electronic warehousing and production equipment.
capabilities: Specialized transport equipment for semiconductor applications

regional_presence.Taiwan: GreenTrans Corporation supplies material transfer equipment to leading wafer manufacturing and packaging and testing plants across Taiwan.
